newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Copper and aluminium looking upwards.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Copper and aluminium looking upwards.

text.p: 3 MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
An upside chart close on Friday has left the copper market open to further gains towards resistance at $2,360 a tonne, traders and chartists said on Monday.
Aluminium was also expected to probe higher after moving above resistance at $1,600 on Friday.
COPPER - The market has the scope to move towards resistance at $2,360 after making an upside chart close on Friday.

"Closed well above resistance from the 10-day moving average at $2,301. The next target on the upside is seen between $2,350 and $2,360 which if achieved would fill the rest of the gap on the chart between $2,308 and $2,365," LME brokers Brandeis said in a commentary.
"With copper closing on the day's highs (Friday) and the technical indicators trending up in support, look for further gains," Martin Squires of Rudolf Wolff said.
Support was pegged at $2,300 followed by $2,280.
According to Harry Creates of broker AMT if $2,302 breaks falls to $2,280 and lower could be seen.
At 0810 GMT three months copper was indicated at $2,323/27, against London's late close Friday of $2,328/32.
ALUMINIUM - Seen firmer after breaking resistance at $1,600 a tonne on Friday.
"A breach of $1,608 signals rallies to $1,620 and $1,628," Harry Creates of AMT said.
At 0910 GMT aluminium was indicated at $1,608, against $1,605/08.
